item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00487","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C19","C02"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.91,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C10 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for two consecutive functions assigned in the child: preparing proposed rules and regulations for presidential consideration and preparing annual reports for presidential submission. The close language, order, and administrative mechanism are substantially more distinctive than a generic delegation of statutory authority. C19 is substantively relevant because it assigns coordination of federal disaster assistance, but its letter form and machinery are less closely reflected in the child. C02 shares the general statutory-delegation form but little distinctive detail.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The preparation of proposed rules and regulations for the consideration of the President and issuance by him under section 5(b) of the act.","parent_excerpt":"After consultation with the Government Patents Board, to formulate and submit to the President for approval such proposed rules and regulations as may be necessary or desirable","explanation":"Both assign an administrator responsibility for preparing proposed regulations that remain subject to presidential approval or issuance."},{"child_excerpt":"The preparation of the annual and supplemental reports provided for by section 8 of the act, for the consideration of the President and transmittal by him to the Congress.","parent_excerpt":"To submit annually a report to the President concerning the operation of such policies","explanation":"The immediately following provision in each document assigns preparation or submission of an annual report to the President, creating a parallel operative sequence."}]}
